Eric Bluestine wrote *The Ways Children Learn Music* (GIA). His blog, [Helping Children Audiate Music](https://ericmbluestine.substack.com), is
on Substack. These pages link to each post, with the site's own summary; the posts themselves are read at his site, used with his
permission. Songs and pieces a post uses are in the [Tune Directory](../practice/tune-directory.qmd).
